title: BRUIN CLL-313: Randomized Phase III Trial of Pirtobrutinib Versus Bendamustine Plus Rituximab in Untreated Patients With Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia/Small Lymphocytic Lymphoma
comparison_or_design: The primary BRUIN CLL-313 efficacy comparison.
time_scope: The final PFS and corresponding interim OS analysis in this article; include only the explicitly requested 24-month PFS landmark.
excluded: Investigator-assessed efficacy, individual best-response categories and other survival landmarks
Crossover-only subsets, subgroup/sensitivity analyses and safety
population_or_material: Treatment-naïve CLL/SLL participants without del(17p) in the BRUIN CLL-313 ITT population.
requested_items: IRC PFS: arm medians, 24-month rates, rate difference and HR. OS: arm medians and primary HR. IRC ORR: arm responder count/proportion and independent CMH test. Exclude investigator/subgroup/sensitivity results.
case_specific_rules: Retain the reported difference in 24-month PFS rates and its own CI. Apply the shared rules for recovering comparison direction from explicit source evidence.
